## Simple Explanation

The Guardian newspaper has started a temporary email newsletter called "Fighting Back." This newsletter will run until Donald Trump officially becomes president (the inauguration).

The newsletter will feature articles from experts sharing advice on how people can protect their rights and freedoms during Trump's time as president. Readers who want to receive these emails can sign up through a link.

The article then gives some practical advice to readers. First, it suggests taking care of yourself emotionally - relax, take a walk, meditate, or talk to people you trust. This is because many readers may feel stressed or worried about the political situation.

Once you feel calmer, the article recommends writing down your personal goals related to an issue you care about. This is called a "mission statement" - basically a clear statement of what you want to achieve and why it matters to you.

Finally, the article asks readers to think about all the different places where decisions get made that affect their issue. These include local government (like city councils), state government, the federal government in Washington DC, businesses and corporations, and community organizations. The idea is to understand how each of these groups connects to the problem you want to solve, so you can figure out the best way to make change happen.
